Ana (PM): Heads-up: post-launch play for the next 72h. Goal = minimize user pain + keep roadmap momentum. Proposal: 'sprintlet' cadence (24h triage, 24h small-batch fixes, 24h groom + next-wave). Opinions?

Marco (Eng): I like sprintlet. Need a clear matrix: Impact x Frequency -> Fix now vs Backlog. Suggest: Severity A = customer-visible regression affecting core flows; Severity B = degraded UX or perf hit; Severity C = edge-case or feature request. A -> hotfix, B -> same-wave patch, C -> next-wave.

Jordan (SRE): Can we quantify "affecting core flows"? My suggestion: >2% of requests or >10 incidents in 1h -> Severity A. Also recommend auto-tagging when Sentry error rate crosses threshold so triage has signals.

Lina (Eng): Technical constraints: anything touching model-serving infra needs a canary + observability checklist. UI/UX patches can go via feature flags and staged release. Small dev rule: PRs for hotfix < 150 LOC and include a rollback plan.

Tara (Design): For B-level UX fixes I'll produce 2 clickable mocks and acceptance criteria (happy path + 1 failure case). If it's a cross-screen change, mark as B-> backlog unless it's high frequency.

Ana (PM): Operational rules: 1) Morning triage (15m) – assign severity + owner 2) If A, page oncall and freeze unrelated merges in target branch 3) B -> owner + single dev for day patch window 4) C -> groom Friday with estimates. Also: flag Dedicated/Enterprise customers with prefix [ENTERPRISE] in ticket.

Marco (Eng): Branching/backport: hotfix branches off `release/1.2` and PR labeled `hotfix/` + severity. Backport checklist: if fix affects older releases, include `cherry-pick: yes` in PR body and list target branches. Example command I use: ```git checkout -b hotfix/1745678901 && git cherry-pick -x <commit> && git push origin hotfix/1745678901```

Jordan (SRE): I'll wire an alert in Vega to tag incidents with `severity:A/B/C` when thresholds hit. Also will post a mini-runbook template for hotfixes in #runbooks.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated by Marco: hotfix/1745678901 -> canary 3% at 1745678950

Ana (PM): Customer escalations: product + CS + AM loop in. If customer is on Dedicated, escalate immediately and create an internal SLUG with customer name.

Tara (Design): I'll attach mocks to the top B tickets and include acceptance checks.

Lina (Eng): Noted. I'll own the first hotfix cycle today and aim for a PR within 3h.

Ana (PM): Thanks team. Friday grooming: bring 4 candidate C-items (low-effort wins) and 2 customer follow-ups. Quick sync at 3pm today to confirm owners. If anyone sees spike in errors, ping me directly. :rocket:
